name: Yash Highvoltage Ltd
title: Yash Highvoltage Ltd - 544310 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Transformer bushing maker guides FY26 EBITDA margin held near 24-25% and FY27 revenue of INR360-400 crore on a 15,000-bushing capacity, with utilisation of 75-80% in FY26 and 65-70% guided for FY27.

utilisation.quote: We have been able to utilize at least 75% to 80% of our existing facility.

capex.peers_comment: Management said peers' capacity additions are mostly at the transformer side; said it was not concerned about lower-kV overcapacity.
capex.quote: I don't believe that we would fall in that trap because capacity addition is happening largely at the transformer side

triggers.label: Utilisation 75-80% FY26
triggers.quote: We have been able to utilize at least 75% to 80% of our existing facility.

triggers.label: Capacity to ~15,000 bushings
triggers.quote: our total capacity will be moving to close to 15,000 bushings.

triggers.label: Price rises passed to customers
triggers.quote: there is an arrangement with the customer that we would also be transferring that price rise to them.

triggers.label: Blanket orders for 24-36 months
triggers.quote: the transformer companies are giving us blanket orders for the next 24 to 36 months

triggers.label: Order inflow target INR500+ crore
triggers.quote: we have a target to book at least INR500 plus crores order this year also.

guidance.quote: between INR360 crores to INR400 crores is our target to invoice this year.
We this year also should be able to maintain around 24%, 25% EBITDA.
we have a target to book at least INR500 plus crores order this year also.
Our target would be that eventually in next two to three years, we at least do 20% plus from exports.

red_flags.label: Cyber incident expensed, no recovery yet
red_flags.quote: We have filed a police complaint and there is an investigation which is happening.

red_flags.label: Management says capacity added is OIP-constrained; RIP core still imported
red_flags.quote: Today, India remains heavily dependent on imported capacity cores for RIP bushings.

red_flags.label: Fundraise approval INR150 crore, target INR100-110 crore, with WC option
red_flags.quote: Around INR100 to INR110 is what we are eyeing.

evasions.quote: Price hike I won't be able to tell very specifically
It will be too early for me to comment.
We don't see any reason to discuss this.

evasions.topic: Gross margin pressure from peer overcapacity
evasions.quote: I don't believe that we would fall in that trap
